correctness.rationale: Complete-forcing condition is that S meet both frames of each nice even cycle, or directly that complement T contain no P\Q for distinct derangement perfect matchings. Disjoint unordered index supports create a nice 4-cycle obstruction n>=4; oriented 3-cycles create nice 6-cycle obstruction n>=5 but not n4 because leftover paired diagonal edge is absent. Conversely pairwise-intersecting 2-subsets form stars or all lie in one triangle; these contain no nice-cycle matching frames except directed triangles already excluded. For one index pair orientation-subsets have weight h=2z+z^2; unique star centers count n binom(n-1,k)h^k, triangle inclusion-exclusion gives h^3-2z^3(1+z)^3+z^6; n3 one six-cycle gives B3 formula. Reconstructed perfect-matching-mask exhaustive independent enumeration agrees for all 2^6,2^12,2^20 complements at n3,4,5, respectively 49,343,1366, and extrema counts 9,8,5. Infinite theorem relies on support/cycle proof, not finite checks.
